summary:
Stage A read-only audit and contract proposal complete against pinned spec 9a4944655ca4cf7f5edc2e0939f654643cdd144d; no tracked source edits, no lease claimed, no production alerts/session/deployment changes. Main baseline 9f6b9760955f0acb2673e2cab8b8a852ec4dd2ac (origin/main verified; local main ahead 3 and dirty, so used git show/grep of immutable objects only); accepted W11 eed1fe1b74fbaf3dca867d7915ffaaeed9767c81 inspected independently (merge-base d702352ef705f9991ac1cb14dc15a13cce78aa44, NOT integrated into pinned main); W18 local branch feat/notification-batch-ack-worker18-20261121 at 500c5c526698477349b6eae875dbfc694a312cc2 directly atop W11, explicit recipient-only ACK not control delivery. W27 task still Started v3, source lease refs/heads/feat/retire-repository-guidance-worker27-20261123; Stage B not authorized.

Minimal contract proposal: retain command result/error and exact immutable job handle/terminal payload; distinguish operational control from receipt. Use a closed typed control DU, e.g. WorkingTurnLimit(level: Soft|Hard; existing policy wording generated in one renderer) and QueuedResponseAlert(alertId, message; project/recipient/issuer/time only where needed for provenance). Explicitly classify STOP by existing trimmed, case-insensitive prefix; stable order STOP first then queue time/ID. No arbitrary instruction/document/path or generic ambient prose cases. Separate command outcome from visible-response controls: background job records contain only original result/error/effect receipts, never consumed one-shot alerts. Preserve existing repeatable timed control semantics unless policy change authorized (including current old terminal timing guidance; test current-session freshness rather than inventing session authority). WorkingTurnGuidance.AgentCache is also used for Ready activation, not removable with repository DeliveryCache. Existing forSession helper is not used by production checkWorkingGuidance, which uses instructionAt on transport actor/current cached record; do not change session resolution or autoactivation here. Do not classify routine notifications as controls; W18 ACK API independent.

Keep explicit StateEffects completeness: Confirmed(changes) vs Pending vs Unknown(knownChanges), separate activation receipt and operation recovery UUID. Unknown may have confirmed subset, never conflate with []; preserve committed Ready->Working even if requested command fails. Pending has no final effects; known source evidence must survive destination promotion/transport uncertainty and cancellation before execution. Keep state-change status metadata/text for nonempty, unknown, activation and generated IDs; recommend preserve current empty confirmed text/meta initially; later omit only with explicit documented/negotiated absence semantics, never infer absent legacy payload as confirmed. Preserve generated operation UUID in copyable text, recovery operation UUID (caller stable) vs diagnostic jarvis/operation_id (not authority), generated task ID, selected-device job provenance, and existing result/error and media semantics. Existing legacy wire is v3.68, negotiation permits compatible commands despite version mismatch. Stage rollout with one domain contract and a narrow wire adapter: typed control + explicit receipt presence for new peer, render/project existing Instructions scope and known legacy evidence for old peer; new server reads known old scopes only for operational compatibility, no duplicated emitted blocks. If no negotiated feature flag available, temporary additive field + legacy projection until coordinated upgrade, old consumers ignore new field, new consumers prefer typed only once capability/presence established; prove old/new deserialization and UpdateClient path. Retire wire adapter after coordinated version gate, not permanent dual pipeline. Preserve typed result of explicit GetAgentInstructions / role layers independently from implicit injection.

Critical exact paths and edge cases in evidence. Existing transport budget is estimated UTF8 sum of unescaped Result + serialized Instructions/changes/activation; alerts added after check; nested JobResult incurs escaping and duplicate presentation, 900 KiB ordinary, special media/poll allowance, server 12 MiB SignalR receive. Measure real serializer/final frames at boundary; don't expand limits arbitrarily or truncate required receipts/STOP. No claims of measured throughput; representative actual body byte deltas and logical file-read work in evidence. Policy: 25/30 minute numbers originated 78b486fe808629deee4b9e16b0dad9a852ec4dd2ac (Oct 29) and are explicit existing spec docs/specs/orchestration-architecture.md 91–103, docs/specs/orthogonal-agent-state.md 141, docs/OrchestrationMigration.md 146. They are wall-clock cooperative bounded-turn advice, not enforcement, scheduling lease, inactivity proof, or forced cancel. No measured justification for numeric constants found. Preserve threshold and behavior in typed control; no Operator decision necessary to preserve, only if changing/removing or strengthening delivery semantics. W11 accepted source intentionally permits deferred delivery after missing hint and best-effort at-most-once loss after consume commit if actual transmission lost. Do not promise exactly once or no loss across already-dispatched aborted HTTP. No new Operator Challenge proposed because preservation is possible; escalate only an actual policy departure.

Then implement typed operational control+receipt adapter only; use existing fence, immutable job and invalidation mechanisms. Red-first focused Client.Tests/Server.Tests Release regression matrix: ordinary/explicit inbox/explicit instruction tool shapes (no ambient, source and task prepared once), real/empty/unknown and error after activation, pending+terminal/cancel/exception/duplicate actor/device/original UUID, mixed-version old/new incl legacy nested job and update bootstrap, STOP-first queue cross-client/restart/cache-negative/lost hint/stale clear/no consumption by observer/internal health/abandoned background completion and no replay on repeated poll, same-source routing and cross-project known evidence+control retention, no polling activation/activity/broadcast duplication, unknown invalidate-all, exact output/media boundary and full response bytes including escaping. Run exact-source scoped Release tests, update schema/docs, submit frozen independent review. No changes to live state or scheduler, no deployment. Stage A read-only work concluded; awaiting Lead dependency resolution.

W11 delta: responseAlertCache is per Runtime canonical-project/exact-agent boolean hint, per-project verified snapshot, background refresh 15s/idle 3m, invalidation+reconnect, positive path always rechecks fence+verified snapshot+CAS, after attempt clears hint/reschedules; errors cannot assert empty or authorize stale delivery. Server immediate successful Queue/Clear invalidates alert target (not a fabricated AgentStateChange). Preserve separate hint, don't report notification ACK/alert queue mutation as agent transition. W18 AcknowledgeNotifications additive transaction 1–64 exact IDs, initiating recipient actor, one receipt; no ambient context, no implicit ACK. Tests/docs source-only; not assumed deployed.

Observed regression candidates for explicit bounded Stage B review: ProjectNotificationRouting.resolveHealth (ClientService.fs 45–89) returns original terminal ToolResponse and drops poll/initial visible controls; internal destination health probe is excluded from alerts but its internal GetJobResult poll is not (ClientService 460–474). Sender validation AgentInbox can consume source alert that mergeStateEffects 526–546 does not forward to final caller. Internal polling should be explicitly non-delivery scope for destination health, not infer identity from destination actor; for initiating source sender validation preserve actual visible controls through final result/error/pending or explicitly defer consumption to actual eligible reply. Distinguish abandon-before-delivery from unavoidable best-effort lost post-CAS transmission, no live test. Verify authorization before any proposed poll decoration; existing authorized caller error poll can carry own alert; preserve policy that poll never activates/updates activity. No cross-owner changes now. Working timing source forSession not used by production, actual policy advisory and not a hard execution fence. Current stored repeatable timing notices can become stale when polled later; avoid replaying operator alerts regardless, test freshness and get authority if changing timing delivery boundary.
